author: C. V. Richardson
title: Erie County extends deadline for purchase of dog tags for 2025
text:
Edward Kosek, Principal at Sandusky High School | Facebook
Edward Kosek, Principal at Sandusky High School | Facebook
The deadline for purchasing 2025 Dog Tags in Erie County has been extended. Residents now have until midnight on February 8, 2026, to obtain the tags. For complete information, individuals are advised to consult Resolution No. 26-24.
In related local education statistics, Sandusky High School reported the highest enrollment among the county's 23 schools during the 2023-24 academic year, with 983 students enrolled according to data from the Ohio Department of Education (https://education.ohio.gov/). The total student enrollment in Erie County for that school year was 11,644, which is a decrease of about one percent compared to the previous year's figure of 11,767 (https://education.ohio.gov/).
Demographic data show that non-Hispanic white students made up the largest portion of Erie County’s student body in 2023-24 at 70.5%, totaling 8,209 students. Non-Hispanic Black students were the second-largest group with 1,247 students or approximately 10.7% (https://education.ohio.gov/).
